test_title: PYST 74: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error’

He then set out on his journey, / and rides on and on till he reached a jungle / where he found some water and shady trees.

options.text: He then set out on his journey,
where he found some water and shady trees.
and rides on and on till he reached a jungle

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the **inconsistency in verb tense.**
 
• The sentence starts with past tense "**set out**" and then shifts to present tense "**rides**", which should be corrected.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**and rode on and on till he reached a jungle**", ensuring consistency in verb tense.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He then set out on his journey,** and rode on and on till he reached a jungle** where he found some water and shady trees."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "He then set out on his journey," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "where he found some water and shady trees."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 3.
